svg.desc: Assembly source: https://spatiaos.github.io/projects/P3D-Bench/ (retrieved 2026-09-11). Text and Image retain the original paper results and model versions. Task order: Assembly-3D, Text-to-3D, Image-to-3D. Bar heights use source Score values; labels round to one decimal.
